scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@frameforge/shared && npm --prefix packages/db run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --workspace=@frameforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@frameforge/web
scripts.render:build:shared: npm --prefix packages/shared install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/shared run build
scripts.render:build:db: npm --prefix packages/db install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/db run generate && npm --prefix packages/db run build
scripts.render:build:api: npm run render:build:shared && npm run render:build:db && npm --prefix apps/api install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.render:build:worker: npm run render:build:shared && npm run render:build:db && npm --prefix apps/worker install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix apps/worker run build
